package domain

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func diagnosticEventFixture() DiagnosticResultCommittedEvent {
	planID := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	return DiagnosticResultCommittedEvent{EventID: DiagnosticResultCommittedEventID(planID), EventType: SubjectDiagnosticResultCommitted, CorrelationID: planID, CausationID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", StudentID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", OccurredAt: time.Date(2026, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 123456000, time.UTC), SchemaVersion: 1, Data: DiagnosticResultCommittedData{PlanID: planID, PlanRevision: 1, PlanDigest: "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("a", 64), ResultDigest: "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("b", 64)}}
}

func TestDiagnosticCommittedDecoderStrictEnvelope(t *testing.T) {
	expected := diagnosticEventFixture()
	body, _ := json.Marshal(expected)
	got, err := DecodeDiagnosticResultCommittedEvent(body)
	if err != nil || got != expected {
		t.Fatalf("got=%#v err=%v", got, err)
	}
	cases := map[string]string{
		"envelope unknown": strings.Replace(string(body), `"event_id":`, `"score":100,"event_id":`, 1),
		"duplicate":        strings.Replace(string(body), `"schema_version":1`, `"schema_version":1,"schema_version":1`, 1),
		"data duplicate":   strings.Replace(string(body), `"plan_revision":1`, `"plan_revision":1,"plan_revision":1`, 1),
		"data unknown":     strings.Replace(string(body), `"plan_revision":1`, `"plan_revision":1,"band":"ADVANCED"`, 1),
		"null":             strings.Replace(string(body), `"plan_revision":1`, `"plan_revision":null`, 1),
		"missing":          strings.Replace(string(body), `"plan_revision":1,`, "", 1),
		"null data":        strings.Replace(string(body), string(mustDiagnosticJSON(expected.Data)), "null", 1),
		"schema":           strings.Replace(string(body), `"schema_version":1`, `"schema_version":2`, 1),
		"schema string":    strings.Replace(string(body), `"schema_version":1`, `"schema_version":"1"`, 1),
		"offset":           strings.Replace(string(body), `05.123456Z`, `05.123456+00:00`, 1),
		"nanos":            strings.Replace(string(body), `05.123456Z`, `05.123456001Z`, 1),
		"trailing":         string(body) + `{}`,
		"oversized":        string(body) + strings.Repeat(" ", MaximumDiagnosticResultEventBytes),
	}
	for name, input := range cases {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			if _, err := DecodeDiagnosticResultCommittedEvent([]byte(input)); err == nil {
				t.Fatal("invalid event accepted")
			}
		})
	}
}
func mustDiagnosticJSON(value any) []byte { body, _ := json.Marshal(value); return body }

func TestDiagnosticCommittedEventIdentityAndBindings(t *testing.T) {
	fixture := diagnosticEventFixture()
	if fixture.EventID != DiagnosticResultCommittedEventID(fixture.Data.PlanID) || fixture.EventID == DiagnosticResultCommittedEventID(fixture.CausationID) {
		t.Fatal("unstable event identity")
	}
	for _, name := range []string{"event_id", "subject", "correlation", "causation", "student", "revision", "digest", "occurred"} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			event := fixture
			switch name {
			case "event_id":
				event.EventID = event.CausationID
			case "subject":
				event.EventType = "student.diagnostic-result.committed.v2"
			case "correlation":
				event.CorrelationID = event.CausationID
			case "causation":
				event.CausationID = ""
			case "student":
				event.StudentID = ""
			case "revision":
				event.Data.PlanRevision = 0
			case "digest":
				event.Data.PlanDigest = ""
			case "occurred":
				event.OccurredAt = time.Time{}
			}
			if ValidateDiagnosticResultCommittedEvent(event) == nil {
				t.Fatal("invalid reference accepted")
			}
		})
	}
}
